records.jp: 詩帆さんって普段本読む？
records.en_original: Do you read much, Shiho?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you read much, Shiho?
records.en: Do you read much, Shiho-san?

records.jp: はい、少しだけですけど
records.en_original: Yes, a bit.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, a bit.
records.en: Yes, a bit.

records.jp: レシピ本とか？
records.en_original: Like cookbooks?
records.en_auxiliary: Like cookbooks?
records.en: Like cookbooks?

records.jp: そうですね。一番よく読むかもしれません
records.en_original: Yes, I probably read those most often.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, I probably read those most often.
records.en: Yes, I probably read those most often.

records.jp: いいですよね、ああいうの。<CR>わたしもいつか出版してみたいな……
records.en_original: I like cookbooks. I'd like to publish my own one day...
records.en_auxiliary: I like cookbooks. I'd like to publish my own one day...
records.en: Cookbooks are wonderful, are they not?<CR>I would like to publish one myself someday...

records.jp: なんて、そう簡単じゃないですよね
records.en_original: But it's harder than it looks.
records.en_auxiliary: But it's harder than it looks.
records.en: But it's harder than it looks.

records.jp: （料理研究家の道か……<CR>詩帆さんならワンチャンある気がする）
records.en_original: (The path of a culinary expert huh... Shiho might actually have a chance at it.)
records.en_auxiliary: (The path of a culinary expert huh... Shiho might actually have a chance at it.)
records.en: (The path of a culinary researcher...<CR>I feel like Shiho-san actually has a chance.)

records.jp: 恋愛ものとか？
records.en_original: Like romance novels?
records.en_auxiliary: Like romance novels?
records.en: Like romance novels?

records.jp: 決めつけてるでしょう！
records.en_original: What makes you think that?!
records.en_auxiliary: What makes you think that?!
records.en: What makes you think that?!

records.jp: え、好きじゃないの？
records.en_original: You mean you don't like them?
records.en_auxiliary: You mean you don't like them?
records.en: You mean you don't like them?

records.jp: それはまぁ……好きですけど
records.en_original: Well... Actually, I do.
records.en_auxiliary: Well... Actually, I do.
records.en: Well... Actually, I do.

records.jp: 星崎さんが好きな本も教えてください
records.en_original: What books would you recommend, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What books would you recommend, Ao?
records.en: What books would you recommend, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: そうだなぁ、小説だったら……
records.en_original: Hmm, if we're talking about novels...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, if we're talking about novels...
records.en: Hmm, if we're talking about novels...

records.jp: （詩帆さん好みっぽいやつにするか）
records.en_original: (Let's go with something Shiho might like.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Let's go with something Shiho might like.)
records.en: (Let's go with something Shiho-san might like.)

records.jp: これとか
records.en_original: This one's pretty good.
records.en_auxiliary: This one's pretty good.
records.en: This one's pretty good.

records.jp: ちょっと読ませてもらってもいいですか？
records.en_original: Do you mind if I read a bit of it now?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you mind if I read a bit of it now?
records.en: Do you mind if I read a bit of it now?

records.jp: ぐすっ……
records.en_original: *Sniff*
records.en_auxiliary: *Sniff*
records.en: *Sniff*

records.jp: え、泣いてる？
records.en_original: A-are you crying?
records.en_auxiliary: A-are you crying?
records.en: A-are you crying?

records.jp: だって、こんなに愛し合ってた二人が<CR>離れ離れになってしまうなんて
records.en_original: It's just... They love each other so much, but they can never be together!
records.en_auxiliary: It's just... They love each other so much, but they can never be together!
records.en: It's just... They love each other so much,<CR>but they can never be together!

records.jp: ひどいです！　<CR>作者の方に抗議して書き換えてもらいます！
records.en_original: How awful! I'm going to complain to the author and have them rewrite it!
records.en_auxiliary: How awful! I'm going to complain to the author and have them rewrite it!
records.en: That is terrible!<CR>I will protest to the author and have them rewrite it!

records.jp: （クレーマーみたいなこと言ってる。<CR>まぁ、それだけ感動したってことか）
records.en_original: (She sounds like one of those crazy fans. She must have been really touched by the story, though.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She sounds like one of those crazy fans. She must have been really touched by the story, though.)
records.en: (She sounds like an unreasonable complainer.<CR>Well, I suppose that shows how moved she was.)

records.jp: これとか
records.en_original: This one's pretty good.
records.en_auxiliary: This one's pretty good.
records.en: This one's pretty good.

records.jp: ちょっと読ませてもらってもいいですか？
records.en_original: Do you mind if I read a bit of it now?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you mind if I read a bit of it now?
records.en: Do you mind if I read a bit of it now?

records.jp: ほ、星崎さん、普段こんなのを<CR>読んでるんですか……？
records.en_original: I-is this the type of thing you normally read, Ao...?
records.en_auxiliary: I-is this the type of thing you normally read, Ao...?
records.en: I-is this the type of thing you normally<CR>read, Hoshizaki-san...?

records.jp: 嗜む程度に
records.en_original: Every now and then.
records.en_auxiliary: Every now and then.
records.en: Every now and then.

records.jp: ダメですよこんなの……
records.en_original: I don't think we should be reading this...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think we should be reading this...
records.en: I don't think we should be reading this...

records.jp: 一応、全年齢のやつなんだけどなぁ。<CR>続きあるけどやめとく？
records.en_original: It says it's for all ages... So I'm guessing you don't want to read the next volume?
records.en_auxiliary: It says it's for all ages... So I'm guessing you don't want to read the next volume?
records.en: It is rated for all ages, at least.<CR>There is another volume, but should we stop?

records.jp: 読みます！
records.en_original: Give it to me!
records.en_auxiliary: Give it to me!
records.en: Give it to me!

records.jp: （ふっふっふ……なんやかんやハマったな）
records.en_original: (Hehehe... Looks like she's hooked.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hehehe... Looks like she's hooked.)
records.en: (Hehehe... Looks like she's hooked.)

records.jp: でも、こういう恋愛憧れちゃいます。<CR>波乱万丈の末に、やっと結ばれるみたいな
records.en_original: That's the kind of love I want... Where you're willing to go through heaven and hell just to be with the person you love in the end.
records.en_auxiliary: That's the kind of love I want... Where you're willing to go through heaven and hell just to be with the person you love in the end.
records.en: Still, I dream of a romance like this.<CR>One where, after endless turmoil, the two are finally united.

records.jp: 楽しそうだよね
records.en_original: Sounds fun, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Sounds fun, right?
records.en: Sounds fun, right?

records.jp: 楽しそう、ですか？
records.en_original: Fun...?
records.en_auxiliary: Fun...?
records.en: Fun...?

records.jp: あれ、ちょっと違った？
records.en_original: Is that not what you meant?
records.en_auxiliary: Is that not what you meant?
records.en: Is that not what you meant?

records.jp: 愛を確かめたり、深められたりできていいよねって<CR>意味で言ったんですけど……
records.en_original: I meant that I admire how that kind of journey would reaffirm and deepen your love for one another...
records.en_auxiliary: I meant that I admire how that kind of journey would reaffirm and deepen your love for one another...
records.en: I meant that it would be wonderful to reaffirm and deepen your love<CR>through those experiences...

records.jp: 辛いこともあるかもしれませんよ？
records.en_original: But there might be hard times too, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: But there might be hard times too, you know?
records.en: But there might be hard times too, you know?

records.jp: え、それが楽しいんじゃないの？<CR>ジェットコースター的な
records.en_original: Exactly! Don't you think that sounds fun? Like a rollercoaster!
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly! Don't you think that sounds fun? Like a rollercoaster!
records.en: Exactly! Don't you think that sounds<CR>fun? Like a rollercoaster!

records.jp: た、タフですね……
records.en_original: Y-you're tougher than you look...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you're tougher than you look...
records.en: Y-you're tougher than you look...

records.jp: えー、なんか疲れそうじゃん？
records.en_original: Really? I think it sounds exhausting.
records.en_auxiliary: Really? I think it sounds exhausting.
records.en: Really? I think it sounds exhausting.

records.jp: 私は穏やかなのがいいなぁ。喧嘩もせず、<CR>のんびり趣味の話とかダベるような関係
records.en_original: I'd rather have a mellow relationship. No fighting, just relaxing and talking about whatever we like.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd rather have a mellow relationship. No fighting, just relaxing and talking about whatever we like.
records.en: I would prefer something peaceful. A relationship without fighting,<CR>where we can relax and chat about our hobbies.

records.jp: それって……
records.en_original: But that's...
records.en_auxiliary: But that's...
records.en: But that's...

records.jp: どうした？
records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: いえ、なんでもないです
records.en_original: N-nothing, never mind.
records.en_auxiliary: N-nothing, never mind.
records.en: N-nothing, never mind.
